checkbox.why: bestax `Checkbox` renders its own styled markup, not Bulma's. Write it by hand in place of the element that carries `.checkbox`, Bulma's `<label>` or a bare `<input>`, with the `<input>`'s attributes on it: `id`, `name`, `aria-label` and the rest reach its `<input>`, and a `<label>`'s text is its children. Drive it with `checked` and `onChange`, and add `indeterminate` for a select-all box. Its `className` goes on its `<label>`, which declares the `--bulma-checkbox-*` variables, so set the page's colors with those in a rule for your class beside `.styled-checkbox`. Where the page put `.checkbox` on a bare `<input>`, drop its own rules for that box, since bestax draws its own and `.checkbox` is on its `<label>` now

omits.is-right: Bulma places it inside a `.control` with `has-icons-right`, and bestax `Control` renders that icon itself from `iconRight` (`iconRight={{ library: "fa", name: "envelope", size: "small" }}`), after its children, so a hidden `.icon` there can go as that prop; on `Icon` the class stays in `className`, which renders the same

modal.why: bestax `Modal` writes a `data-testid` of its own over the one it's given, and adds dialog attributes and focus handling, so rebuild the root with it by hand; its parts convert on their own

a `.fixed-grid` column count, which converts only on its own `.fixed-grid`
an `.image` modifier, which converts only on its own `.image`, and only where bestax has a prop for it
a Bulma helper with no bestax prop
Bulma's other name for `m-0` or `p-0`, with the same rule; bestax writes that rule as `m="0"` or `p="0"`, which renders `m-0` or `p-0`, so the class stays as it is
a `.breadcrumb` separator, which converts only on its own `.breadcrumb`
`.select`'s `is-multiple`, which converts only on its own `.select`, around a `<select multiple>`
a modifier of markup this source leaves alone, or one bestax has no prop for
